Lets your paired Mac tap, swipe and type on this phone: during a screen session you approved, and in the Mac\'s keyboard window when you type from the Mac. Tether only acts on input you send from your Mac. If you turn on Continue on Mac › Current browser tab, it also reads the address bar of Chrome, Brave, Edge or Samsung Internet to offer that page on your Mac. If you turn on Instant Hotspot automation, it opens the hotspot settings screen and taps its switch when your Mac asks to join. Nothing else on screen is read or stored.
